identifiedGap.currentClaim: Four people died, hundreds were contaminated or exposed, buildings were demolished and thousands of cubic metres of radioactive waste were generated.
identifiedGap.finding: The wording collapses distinct monitored, contaminated, hospitalized, and fatality cohorts and leaves cleanup quantities vague despite exact counts in the cited IAEA report.

proposedReplacement: Fragments travelled through families and neighbourhoods before the source was recognized. The IAEA reports that about 112,000 people were monitored, 249 were found internally or externally contaminated, 20 required hospital treatment and four died. Cleanup included the demolition of seven houses, and the response ultimately stored 3,500 cubic metres of radioactive waste.
